summary.text: Jeff Polonowski is the Green Party nominee for Michigan Attorney General. BallotReady lists him as a retired Perrigo Company senior scientist with a chemistry degree from Calvin College.

paragraphs.text: Polonowski earned a bachelor's degree in chemistry from Calvin College in 1977 and worked as a senior scientist at Perrigo Company from 1980 to 2017.
